channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Rock Block D2

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block D2: Block D2's record and map shape now say: the April 2017 Draft EIR puts about 2,300 spaces in the Block D2 garage (with 700 more under Mission Rock Square), so the earlier 'not confirmed as D2 alone' was removed; the 1,000 to 1,500 car and 750 to 1,000 space interim parking figures are a 2019 forecast, not a present count; the land-use plan cited is the Design Controls', not the 2012 proposal; the earlier statement that the lots match the plan within 3% is corrected by a new dated note; the Port Commission actions of 2018, 2023, 2025 and 2026 cite the minutes and misquoted wording was corrected; and source citations were fixed. The shape is unchanged.

item.title: Correction · Mission Rock Block D2: The Jan 30, 2018 approval milestone cited 'Resolutions 18-03, 18-04'. Port sources number the Design Controls resolution differently (the Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested it as 18-04; the Sept 2019 Port memo numbers it 18.05), and the Jan 30, 2018 minutes record Resolutions 18-03 to 18-10 as adopted, so the milestone now cites that range.

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block D2: Port Commission approves Resolution 26-34, authorizing up to $10 million in Port Capital as pre-development funding for Phase 2 (design/engineering for Phase 2 infrastructure and vertical buildings), intended to avoid a 12-18 month delay to construction readiness. Staff's schedule contemplates horizontal infrastructure and vertical building construction beginning as early as Summer/Fall 2027, but the memo's own Table 1 gives illustrative repayment scenarios for a 2027, 2028 or 2029 vertical construction start, contingent on the Developer securing anchor tenants -- not a committed date for this or any other Phase 2 block. (Jun 9, 2026)

item.title: Milestone · Mission Rock Block D2: Port staff say later phases 'may require higher percentages of BMR units' to reach the project's 40% target after Phase 1 was cut to 132 BMR units; the Port, developer and MOHCD are reviewing changes 'with the goal of improving the feasibility of future Phases of Mission Rock and accelerating development' (Resolution 25-17) (Mar 11, 2025)

item.title: Planned · Mission Rock Block D2: Port Commission adopts Resolution 23-46 (passed unanimously as amended, with non-substantive changes); its recitals state that Phase 2 is 'not currently financially feasible' and that Port and Developer staff 'mutually agreed earlier this year to decelerate work on Phase 2 while waiting for macroeconomic conditions to improve' (Oct 10, 2023)

Source: Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-06; Port of San Francisco, 2023-10-10.
